text: NF. USNF 26 (Cetrimonium Bromide). A white to creamy white, voluminous, free-flowing powder, with a characteristic faint odour. Freely soluble in water and in alcohol; practically insolu- ble in ether. Cetrimonium Chloride (BAN) Cetrimonio, cloruro de. Hexadecyltrimethylammonium chlo- ride. C19H42ClN = 320.0. CAS — 112-02-7. Profile Cetrimonium bromide is a quaternary ammonium antiseptic with actions and uses similar to those of other cationic surfactants (see Cetrimide, p.1634). Cetrimonium chloride and cetrimonium tosilate are also used.
